## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev` (not `main`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` · `npm run test` · `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] New pure logic has unit tests; new user-facing behavior has an e2e assertion
- [ ] No secrets or build artifacts in the diff
- [ ] Screenshot / clip attached for visual changes
- [ ] Updated CLAUDE.md / docs if this changes architecture or conventions
